title: The invoice PDF and email show the no-charge line the same way
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a contact whose email the tester can read.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status invoiced, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, line 2 marked No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Download the invoice PDF.
  4. Email the invoice to the contact.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice shows.

Step 3:

  • The PDF shows line 2 at $0.00 with "Goodwill" under its title.

Step 4:

  • The email's invoice shows line 2 at $0.00 with "Goodwill" under its title.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R7: “Create invoice works as today. The invoice (preview, PDF, email, portal) shows the no-charge line with its hours and parts at $0.00 and the category name as a line under the title ("Warranty"); no stamp, no badge, no "No Charge" wording elsewhere on the document. The invoice statement of the line is priced 0 and flagged no_charge with the category and the original work order, line and technician, the way a declined line's statement is priced 0 today; its items are priced 0. The statement keeps the line's hours and labour rate for the record.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Invoice with a no-charge line | "[Category]" under the line title; the line at $0.00 | Invoice preview, PDF, email and portal; no stamp, no badge (S12-R7)”
